body_html:
Add flexible towel storage to your bathroom without wall mounting with this freestanding 4-arm swing towel stand, crafted from solid brass with a heavy base for stability in Fire Engine Red, which makes a fearless design statement, transforming functional bathroom hardware into a vibrant focal point. A bold choice for those who embrace color and personality in their space.

  • Fire Engine Red transforms this essential into a conversation piece
  • Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
  • Solid brass construction: designed for corrosion-free and rust-free performance
  • Stability + floor protection: heavy solid brass base helps prevent tipping; felt pad helps prevent scratching
  • Coordinated look: part of the Soho collection with multiple designer finish options available
